candidate_workaround: Use a non-login shell and split repository probes into exact bounded Git primitives before retrying ordinary status.
failure_signature: Login-shell repository probes exceeded their bounded timeouts without returning evidence.
recurrence_guard: Treat a timeout as missing evidence, retain each failed witness, and change only invocation mode or probe granularity before retry.
rollback: Discard every timed-out result; none supplies clean-state, exact-head, or process-state credit and none changed repository or external state.
scope_boundary: Tamar v648-v1 lifecycle diagnostics only; no scientific, operational, production, security-complete, or independent-reproduction claim.
title: Recover bounded repository reads by changing invocation mode and probe granularity
trigger_preconditions: A required read-only repository or process probe times out before returning usable evidence.
